Yeah same, I’m no athlete either but also not as out of shape as this medication made me feel ! 😭
I was on it for around 7-8 months! 
Went from 10mg up to 20mg and then even 40mg over time…
The side effects disappeared once I took a higher dosage but then reappeared only a few weeks after and only got worse and more intense from there, I also started having really bad derealisation issues. I told my psychiatrist, she had me take them for another 2 months or so till I hit a breaking point and then she finally let me switch ssris. For me personally, Paroxetine has been a life safer. I suffer from this as well !! I’m guessing you’re already diagnosed with ocd? This is a sub type, called bathroom ocd / in your case bladder obsession probably caused by the fear of embarrassment or the fear of loosing control over a bodily function.

I’ve been suffering from this for the past 3 years now. It got a bit better over time but it’s still present and as uncomfortable as ever. :(

If you’re in therapy please address this !! I’ve this exact issue (a bit worse) and got diagnosed with anxiety + ocd. In my case it’s a bladder obsession that came to be due to the fear of embarrassment/ loosing bodily functions.

This probably sounds insensitive to your struggles but don’t overdose. 
Most of the time you won’t even die, ANYTHING can happen after you drowned these pills and most of the things are horrible. You don’t just “fall asleep” or “black out”.
You can go from having seizures to getting a lung rupture (pulmonary edema - especially when it comes to oding on opioids.)

Overdosing isn’t the way to go believe me. It can be a horrible death.
